categories.reasoning: Brand colors (cyan, purple, pink) use proper tokens. Neutral text colors use Tailwind defaults instead of design system tokens.
Spacing uses Tailwind utility classes which align with design system scale
Font family defined correctly via CSS custom property --font-sans
Brand colors used semantically: cyan for primary/links, purple for accents/focus, pink for tertiary highlights
Components follow consistent patterns with proper color variants
Focus rings, prefers-reduced-motion, aria-labels, and keyboard navigation properly implemented

findings.title: Hardcoded body text color
findings.details: Body color uses hardcoded `#f1f5f9` instead of design token
findings.recommendation: Replace `color: #f1f5f9` with `color: var(--color-plexus-text)` or define `--color-plexus-text: #f1f5f9` and reference it

findings.title: Tailwind gray classes instead of design tokens
findings.details: Uses `text-gray-300` and `text-gray-400` instead of design system text tokens
findings.recommendation: Define Tailwind classes for design system text colors: `text-plexus-text` (#f1f5f9) and `text-plexus-text-muted` (#94a3b8)

findings.title: Tailwind gray classes in Footer
findings.details: Uses `text-gray-400`, `text-gray-500`, `text-gray-600` instead of design system tokens

findings.title: Missing text color tokens in Tailwind theme
findings.details: Tailwind @theme block defines brand colors but not text/text-muted tokens

findings.title: Excellent gradient usage
findings.details: Gradient text utility correctly uses brand colors in proper order: cyan → purple → pink

findings.title: Focus ring implementation
findings.details: Proper focus-visible ring using design system purple with correct offset for dark background

decision.reasoning: 4 medium severity findings (non-blocking). Website demonstrates good design system compliance for brand colors, but inconsistently uses Tailwind default gray classes instead of design system text tokens. This is a pattern issue that should be addressed for full consistency.

immediate: Add text color tokens to Tailwind @theme block: --color-plexus-text and --color-plexus-text-muted
short_term: Search and replace `text-gray-500`, `text-gray-600` with `text-plexus-text-muted` or create additional token
long_term: Consider adding a lint rule to flag Tailwind gray classes in favor of design system tokens
Document the full color mapping in design-system.json including neutral text colors

notes: The PlexusOne website shows mature design system adoption. Brand colors (cyan, purple, pink) are consistently tokenized. The main gap is neutral text colors which use Tailwind defaults. MkDocs CSS shows complete token compliance. Accessibility implementation is exemplary.
